issue.title: R4 · Chaos options for the browser test
issue.body:
**PRD ID:** R4
### Summary
Builds on #35 (timings). Lets us measure loss before changing the design.
### Acceptance (Given / When / Then)
`npm run test:browsers -- --drop 10` drops 10% of relay frames. Other options stop a holder halfway, delay a device and corrupt a piece. Each run writes JSON: time to arrive, bytes sent compared with the file size, pieces asked again and whether the SHA-256 matched. Edge: with `--drop 0` the results match a normal run. Blocked by #35.
